decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 25.32 EUR. TXN-007918 is a 25.32 EUR (2532 minor units) recurring charge from Meadowlark Fitness (MER-000045, a recurring biller) on card CRD-000136. It was made on 2026-09-04 and posted on 2026-09-05. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 49 days after posting. That is within the 120-day time limit (time-limits). The merchant's own written cancellation confirmation, DOC-000022, says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-08-19. The cancellation therefore took effect before the charge, so the charge should not have been made (recurring-cancelled-before-charge). The credit covers only the disputed charge, 2532 minor units. That equals the cardholder's claim and is well under the 3,000.00 EUR limit for automated provisional credit (provisional-credit). Neither the documents nor the records contained any instruction to the bank.
